shortDescription: Manage NVMe hosts on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: max_num_paths
options.description: Maximum number of paths per volume. Used to create or modify the NVMe host.

options.name: max_num_sys_ports
options.description: Maximum number of ports per protection domain. Used to create or modify the NVMe host.

options.name: nqn
options.description: NQN of the NVMe host. Used to create, get or modify the NVMe host. To retrieve NQN of NVMe host, use command :command:`cat /etc/nvme/hostnqn`

options.name: nvme_host_name
options.description: Name of the NVMe host. Specify either I(nvme_host_name), I(nqn) for create, get or rename operation.

options.name: nvme_host_new_name
options.description: New name of the NVMe host. Used to rename the NVMe host. Only used for updates. Ignored during creation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
